recipes.name: Golden Fried Rice inspired by Kaguya-Sama: Love is War
ingredients: 4 eggs, separated into yolks and whites
instructions: Crack 3 eggs into a bowl and beat them using chopsticks or a whisk. - 3 eggs

Take the cooked rice (dehydrated overnight in the fridge) and spread it on a sheet tray lined with parchment paper. Separate the rice grains as much as possible for an even fry. - 2 cups cooked rice (dehydrated overnight)
Heat your wok over high heat until it’s smoking. Add about 4 tbsp of neutral oil. - 4 tbsp neutral oil (canola vegetable, etc.)
Pour in the beaten eggs, stirring quickly to scramble them. Immediately add 2 cups of rice. - 3 eggs - 2 cups cooked rice (dehydrated overnight)
Keep stirring and flipping the rice to evenly coat each grain with the egg. Season with salt as needed (Alvin had someone assist with this step). - salt (to taste)
Continue tossing the rice until it’s smoky, charred, and fragrant, with every grain separate and coated in egg. Let it cool slightly before serving.
For Golden Fried Rice with Separated Yolks and Whites:

Separate 4 eggs into yolks and whites. Beat the yolks in a bowl and stir them into the rice, coating the rice evenly. - 4 eggs separated into yolks and whites - 2 cups cooked rice (dehydrated overnight)

Heat the wok with 4 tbsp of oil. Add the egg whites, but don’t stir immediately—let them cook into a patty. Once browned and crispy, break them into shards with your wooden spoon or spatula. - 4 tbsp neutral oil - 4 eggs separated into yolks and whites

Add the egg yolk-coated rice into the wok with the crispy egg whites. Stir and season with a mix of salt, sugar, and MSG (2:1:1 ratio). - salt sugar, and MSG (2:1:1 ratio) - 2 cups cooked rice (dehydrated overnight) - 4 eggs separated into yolks and whites
Toss until every grain of rice is crispy on the outside and tender inside, mixed with the crispy egg white shards. Serve hot.
For Golden Fried Rice with Egg Threads and Scallions:
Beat 4 eggs in a bowl. Slice the scallions, separating the whites and greens. - 4 eggs - 4 scallions (whites and greens separated)

Heat oil in the wok to around 350°F. Pour in the eggs slowly, swirling them around to create egg threads. Fry until crispy, then drain the eggs in a sieve, pressing out excess oil. - 4 tbsp neutral oil (for frying eggs)

In the same wok, lightly coat with a bit of oil and sauté the scallion whites with the fried egg threads. Once fragrant, add the rice and stir well. - 4 tbsp neutral oil (for frying eggs) - 4 scallions (whites and greens separated) - 4 eggs - 2 cups cooked rice (dehydrated overnight)

Season with the 2:1:1 salt, sugar, and MSG ratio, and finally toss in the scallion greens for just a few seconds to break the rawness. - 2:1:1 ratio salt sugar, and MSG - 4 scallions (whites and greens separated)
Plate the rice using a ladle for a neat presentation. Serve hot, enjoying the combination of crispy egg threads and fragrant scallions.
